# Guard an empty saved-search URI string before splitting and resolving folders

In updateOnlineSearchState at fixed revision0b93f0f7a926ed94c8a0646f18b6734ec7cc0f6d, gSearchFolderURIs short-circuits before split("|") and getExistingFolder(folderURI).server. An empty string splits into a one-element array containing an empty string; it is not an empty collection. The accepted local guard prevents resolving that empty URI in this predicate. D232274 proposed removing the check, but the author supplied the null-folder server-access counterexample and the landing retains it. This is the contract of this URI-string predicate, not a general rejection of optional chaining or all invalid URI handling. Static source and complete review context only; no dialog or exception reproduction ran.

Scope: Saved-search online eligibility.
